contentBlocks.text: This week you built and delivered a real speech from scratch. Let's review everything!

Quick review: a speech needs a hook, main points, and a closing (Day 1). Delivery skills — eye contact, pacing, and vocal variety — change how convincing the same words sound (Day 2). Spoken evidence must be brief and memorable (Day 3). You practiced and delivered a complete speech (Day 4). Write a short paragraph explaining which of this week's four skills you think matters most, and why.
Great work this week — you built and delivered a real speech! Next week we'll build on these skills with something new.

objectives: Review speech structure, delivery skills, evidence, and full delivery
Explain in writing which skill matters most and why
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child write their short paragraph explaining which skill matters most.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing a full week of public-speaking skills!
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just the skill the child found hardest this week (often delivery) rather than requiring an even opinion across all four
Ready for more: ask the child to compare how this week's spoken evidence differs from last week's written essay evidence
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the week's four public-speaking skills needs the most reinforcement going forward
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended reflection activity — check that the child names a specific skill from the week and gives a genuine reason, not just a restatement of the skill's definition.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's Common Core Grade 8 Speaking and Listening standards (SL.8.4/SL.8.6) before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session, and opens the public-speaking thread named in the course's own description.

generationData.instructions: Answer to review this week's public-speaking skills.

prompts.prompt: Which skill from this week matters most, and why?
